scope: Bounded one-dimensional int/string arrays and prior table/module subset; not a complete QLIE runtime

contracts.implemented: Unindexed int/str declarations have one element. One integer dimension expression is evaluated without writes, then values below one clamp to one. Larger allocations stop at explicit limits.

Plain variable name selects element zero; a single integer coordinate selects a bounded element. String access returns the whole stored element. Int and str elements initialize to zero and empty string.
Same-type indexed assignment, frame-local shadowing and global result element zero. Nested assignments and index side effects are rejected. Prior atomic instruction commit policy retained.

unchanged_limits: Other catalog/table/expression limits remain as in v3/v2/v1 and source code
